# timeline-kinds fixture

- `shapes-r495.json` holds the key order and leaf types (no values) of
  timelines saved by the Construct 3 r495.2 editor: value tracks, audio
  tracks, track folders, property-track folders, custom eases,
  `transitionsData` and the project's timelines container.
- `Legacy.json` is a timeline with one untyped (legacy) track, cut down from
  an editor-saved timeline and given neutral values.
